summary: This filing is an 8-K reporting a helium offtake agreement, not a special situation. U.S. Energy Corp. entered a five-year Helium Sales Agreement to sell 100% of contained helium from its Montana plant (max 1.2 MMcf/mo) to an investment-grade industrial gas company at a fixed base price of $285/MCF, annually CPI-adjusted from 2028. The expected commencement is March 2027, with a July 2027 outside date. There is no ownership change, M&A, tender, or restructuring; this is a standard long-term supply contract.
